scope: D3D9 windowed UNKNOWN format selection only: live current adapter format on CreateDevice, Reset and additional-chain creation; explicit formats bypass Win32 querying and preserve their value. Fullscreen UNKNOWN is rejected before allocation/queue/physical mode work; failed Reset remains NOTRESET until recovery. D3D8 UNKNOWN behavior remains unchanged. Existing 16-bit Win32 mode mapping/fallback from 4H6f4b is reused; no new native Microsoft HAL or GPU pixel claim. Full mode/refresh/MSAA validation, physical device loss, multiple buffers, wrapping and stages 4/5/6 remain incomplete.

sources.evidence: Windows CreateDevice/Reset UNKNOWN cases return a concrete effective backbuffer format; adapter mode remains independently queryable.

documentation.fact: Windowed UNKNOWN selects the current display mode format. Explicit valid backbuffer formats may differ from desktop format.
Windowed CreateDevice/Reset/CreateAdditionalSwapChain allow UNKNOWN; fullscreen requires an explicit format. Caller field behavior follows the pinned Wine Windows expectations documented in 4H6f6a.
